products.name: Royal Red Rose Bouquet
products.short_description: A classic dozen of velvety red roses, hand-tied with eucalyptus.
products.description: Twelve premium long-stem red roses wrapped with fresh eucalyptus and finished in soft kraft paper with satin ribbon. A timeless way to say "I love you." Freshly cut and delivered same day across the Kathmandu Valley.

products.name: Classic Dozen Red Roses
products.short_description: Twelve deep-red roses arranged in a rounded, romantic dome.
products.description: Our signature dome-style arrangement of twelve deep red roses, complemented with seasonal greens. Available with or without a glass vase. Perfect for anniversaries and grand romantic gestures.

products.name: Pastel Pink Rose Basket
products.short_description: Soft blush roses arranged in a woven cane basket.
products.description: Eighteen blush-pink roses nestled in a handwoven cane basket with baby’s breath and trailing greenery. A graceful gift for mothers, mentors, and cherished friends.

products.name: White Rose Elegance Bouquet
products.short_description: Pure white roses for moments that call for quiet elegance.
products.description: Fifteen pristine white roses hand-tied with silver dollar eucalyptus. Ideal for sympathy, weddings, or simply celebrating new beginnings.

products.name: Dutch Tulip Delight
products.short_description: Twenty fresh Dutch tulips in a lively mixed palette.
products.description: A cheerful bunch of twenty imported Dutch tulips in shades of pink, yellow and red, wrapped in textured paper. Tulips continue to grow after cutting, giving your gift days of changing beauty.

products.name: Rainbow Tulip Bunch
products.short_description: A joyful rainbow mix of twenty-four premium tulips.
products.description: Twenty-four tulips spanning the full colour spectrum, gathered into a generous, garden-style bunch. A statement gift for someone who loves bold colour.

products.name: Pink Tulip Romance
products.short_description: Delicate pink tulips for a soft, romantic gesture.
products.description: Fifteen soft pink tulips finished with a satin wrap. Simple, elegant, and perfect for a first date or a quiet thank-you.

products.name: White Lily Grace Bouquet
products.short_description: Fragrant white oriental lilies with elegant, open blooms.
products.description: Six stems of oriental lilies known for their heady fragrance and star-shaped blooms, paired with soft greenery. A graceful choice for congratulations or sympathy.

products.name: Stargazer Lily Basket
products.short_description: Vivid pink stargazer lilies arranged in a ceramic basket.
products.description: Eight dramatic stargazer lilies with their signature crimson-pink petals, arranged in a natural cane basket. Long-lasting and deeply fragrant.

products.name: Lily & Rose Fusion
products.short_description: White lilies and blush roses combined for maximum elegance.
products.description: A refined pairing of white oriental lilies and blush pink roses, finished with eucalyptus sprigs. One of our most requested arrangements for anniversaries.

products.name: Sunshine Sunflower Bunch
products.short_description: Eight cheerful sunflowers wrapped in rustic brown paper.
products.description: A simple, joyful bunch of eight large-headed sunflowers. Guaranteed to bring a smile — perfect for birthdays, get-well wishes, or just because.

products.name: Golden Sunflower Basket
products.short_description: A generous basket of golden sunflowers and green accents.
products.description: Ten sunflowers arranged in a woven basket with lush foliage. Bright and long-lasting, this arrangement brings warmth to any home or office.

products.name: Sunflower & Daisy Mix
products.short_description: Sunflowers paired with gerbera daisies for a fresh garden feel.
products.description: A fresh, garden-inspired mix of sunflowers and gerbera daisies gathered with seasonal greens. A wonderfully cheerful gift for any occasion.

products.name: Everbloom Signature Mix
products.short_description: Our most-loved seasonal mix, curated fresh by our florists daily.
products.description: Our signature arrangement changes with the season, always featuring the freshest premium blooms available — think garden roses, peonies, ranunculus and delicate fillers. No two bouquets are exactly alike.

products.name: Garden Fresh Mixed Bouquet
products.short_description: A relaxed, garden-style gathering of seasonal flowers.
products.description: Loose and romantic, this garden-style bouquet combines whatever is freshest that day — from gerbera to spray roses — for an effortlessly beautiful gift.

products.name: Pastel Dream Bouquet
products.short_description: Soft pastel tones in a dreamy, romantic bouquet.
products.description: A soft palette of blush, lilac and cream blooms come together in this dreamy bouquet, perfect for baby showers, birthdays, or simply brightening someone’s day.

products.name: Vibrant Spring Mix
products.short_description: A lively mix bursting with spring colour.
products.description: Bold and bright, this mix layers vivid seasonal flowers for a gift that demands attention — ideal for celebrations and congratulations.

products.name: Happy Birthday Bloom Box
products.short_description: A festive box of bright blooms to celebrate their big day.
products.description: A cheerful hatbox arrangement bursting with gerberas, roses and seasonal fillers in birthday-bright colours. Comes with a complimentary "Happy Birthday" card.

products.name: Confetti Birthday Bouquet
products.short_description: A playful, colour-popping bouquet for birthday celebrations.
products.description: Vivid multicoloured gerbera daisies tied together for a fun, celebratory feel — because birthdays deserve a burst of colour.

products.name: Birthday Cake & Flowers Combo
products.short_description: A birthday bouquet paired with a delicious mini celebration cake.
products.description: Our birthday bouquet paired with a freshly baked mini celebration cake, decorated with delicate sugar roses — a complete birthday-in-a-box surprise.

products.name: Eternal Love Anniversary Bouquet
products.short_description: Two dozen red roses for a love that lasts.
products.description: Twenty-four premium red roses arranged in a lush, romantic dome — an unforgettable gesture for milestone anniversaries.

products.name: Romantic Rose & Lily Duo
products.short_description: Roses and lilies combined for a rich, romantic statement.
products.description: A luxurious pairing of garden roses and fragrant lilies, styled in a low, romantic arrangement perfect for a candlelit anniversary dinner table.

products.name: Golden Years Anniversary Basket
products.short_description: An elegant premium basket for milestone anniversaries.
products.description: A grand, premium basket arrangement featuring peonies and seasonal luxury blooms — reserved for the anniversaries worth celebrating in style.

products.name: Bridal Elegance Bouquet
products.short_description: A romantic hand-tied bridal bouquet in ivory and blush.
products.description: A cascading hand-tied bridal bouquet featuring garden roses, ranunculus and trailing greenery in soft ivory and blush tones. Custom colour palettes available on request.

products.name: Wedding Aisle Arrangement
products.short_description: A grand floral piece designed for aisles and mandaps.
products.description: A large-scale floral arrangement designed to make a statement at your mandap or aisle entrance. Fully customisable in colour and flower type for your wedding theme.

products.name: Mandap Marigold & Rose Special
products.short_description: Traditional marigold and rose styling for Nepali weddings.
products.description: A traditional-meets-modern arrangement combining vibrant marigolds and roses, styled for mandap decor and Nepali wedding ceremonies.

products.name: Rustic Dried Bouquet
products.short_description: A rustic, long-lasting bouquet of naturally dried flowers.
products.description: A beautifully textured bouquet of dried strawflowers and wildflowers that keeps its charm for months without water. A wonderful low-maintenance gift.

products.name: Flowers & Chocolate Hamper
products.short_description: A fresh bouquet paired with premium assorted chocolates.
products.description: A charming hand-tied hydrangea bouquet presented alongside a box of premium assorted chocolates — a complete gift for any celebration.

products.name: Blooms & Wine Gift Box
products.short_description: Fresh blooms paired with a bottle of wine, beautifully boxed.
products.description: An elegant gift box combining a rose, hydrangea and calla lily bouquet with a bottle of wine, wrapped and ribboned for an impressive presentation.

products.name: Nepali Festive Hamper
products.short_description: A festive hamper of marigolds and treats for Dashain & Tihar.
products.description: Celebrate Dashain and Tihar with this festive hamper featuring traditional marigold garlands paired with sweets and treats — delivered to your loved ones anywhere in Nepal.

products.name: Everlasting Dried Flower Bunch
products.short_description: A soft, everlasting bunch of naturally dried blooms.
products.description: A gently textured bunch of naturally dried flowers — an on-trend, everlasting accent that keeps its beauty for months with zero maintenance.

products.name: Cheerful Get Well Bouquet
products.short_description: A bright, gentle bouquet to bring comfort and cheer.
products.description: A soft, uplifting mix of gerbera daisies and wildflowers, thoughtfully arranged to bring warmth and encouragement to someone on the mend.
